content.title: Image caption vote
content.summary: Share images, caption an offered image, then vote on other participants’ captions.
content.setup: Invite participants and choose source, response, and vote deadlines plus a round ID.
content.prompt: Share an image that could inspire a playful caption.
content.participant: Upload an image, submit it, caption one of two offered images, and vote once for another participant’s caption.
content.completion: At the vote deadline, show caption vote totals and every tied winner.
content.access: Participants need access to image upload and viewing as well as text entry. Hosts must store and authorize actual image references.

provenance.rights: Illustrative package content; reuse terms have not been specified.
